tasks.prompt:
Audit the satellite site abwex.com (hosted on GitHub Pages). 

1. The sitemap is at https://abwex.com/sitemap.xml — fetch it and get ALL URLs
2. For each URL, make an HTTP request and check these 8 quality gates:
   - G1: Title tag under 60 chars
   - G2: Meta description under 155 chars  
   - G3: Canonical URL matches page URL
   - G4: JSON-LD schema (application/ld+json) exists and is valid JSON
   - G5: Interactive JavaScript exists (real <script> blocks with functionality, not just JSON-LD)
   - G6: Footer with copyright notice
   - G7: Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description)
   - G8: HTTP 200 status
3. Check if https://abwex.com/tools/ returns 200 (tools index page)
4. Check if https://abwex.com/ads.txt returns 200

Domain info: 31 expected pages, 362 impressions (90d), hosted on GH.

Output ONLY a JSON object with the audit results. No markdown fences. No explanation text.
